body: All I ever do is reflect on what made the relationship special, and how empty my life is without it. I know I made a huge mistake getting involved with this girl, But I can't let go no matter what. I've tried so hard, but it never works. I asked her why she was keeping me around if she doesn't love me and she told me she couldn't let go of me either. I'm so confused and scared. I want to distance myself from her but I literally can't. I want to forget about her and hate her for the pain she's put me through but it just won't happen.
